verdicts.evidence: Before we get going, I'll just let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording in the opening turn, within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: Can I get your full name as it would appear on a policy, and your date of birth?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing any details or product, and the customer supplied both.

verdicts.evidence: Roughly what's left on the mortgage, if you don't mind me asking? And do you have any coverage now, through work or otherwise?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked why he wanted cover, who it was for, the mortgage and existing cover before recommending a term and amount.

verdicts.evidence: Coverage can be anywhere from fifty thousand up to seven hundred and fifty thousand dollars. You pick a term of either ten or twenty years, and your premium is fixed for the whole term, so it won't go up partway through.
verdicts.reason: Everything stated matches the product facts: range, terms, fixed premiums, no exam with health questions, no cash value and a 30-day free look with a full refund.

verdicts.evidence: There's no deadline on any of this. Whenever you and <PERSON> are ready, just give us a call back, and we can do the health questions then and get you an actual quote.
verdicts.reason: The agent let the customer decide in his own time, explicitly said it's not a reason to rush, and offered no false urgency or pushy follow-up.

verdicts.evidence: Whenever you and <PERSON> are ready, just give us a call back, and we can do the health questions then and get you an actual quote.

verdicts.evidence: That sounds really sensible. Talking it through with <PERSON> is a good idea, especially since she's the one the coverage is for.
verdicts.reason: The customer showed some vulnerability (a recent diagnosis that rattled him, and feeling overwhelmed). The agent slowed down, acknowledged it, supported involving his wife, and offered to send a summary with no pressure.
